## Scope

- [ ] The change stays within the synthetic, read-only reference scope.
- [ ] No real customer data, credentials, rates, fees, or banking integrations are included.
- [ ] Regulated or irreversible decisions remain human-controlled.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, lint, strict typing, and tests pass.
- [ ] Security and policy evaluation gates pass.
- [ ] Documentation and threat assumptions are updated when needed.

## Evidence

List the exact commit and checks used. Passing tests do not establish legal compliance or
production readiness.
